source.description: Production source after the formation, field-goal, badge, wordmark, and balance-audit implementation and before this evidence-only closeout.

commands.final_clean_tree: git status --short && npm test -- --run && npm run build && git diff ec70bc9..HEAD --check

operations: Connected to the production preview through CDP Runtime, Page, Emulation, Input, and captureScreenshot methods.
Set 1440x900, 390x844, and 320x568 CSS-pixel viewports at deviceScaleFactor 1.
Navigated the production UI from pregame through coin toss, kickoff, return, next down, and formation selection using rendered controls.
Dispatched keyboard Enter on the focused skip link and inspected activeElement and the computed heading outline.
Changed native select values with bubbling change events, compared before/after board signatures, and activated rendered confirmation buttons.
Read the wordmark foreground from its rendered computed style and used that RGB value for pixel-by-pixel WCAG contrast calculation.

Required the exact six ordered value/label pairs for each selector, exact 44px height, explicit foreground/background colors, visible labels/descriptions, pending status, and enabled pre-confirmation state.
Required the exact Trips and Deep Shell values and descriptions before and after confirmation, a changed board signature, confirmed status, and disabled selector/button state.

Added pass-target and tackle-target classes one at a time to the same rendered occupied ball square; required exact P/T content, 1px left/bottom placement, 10px size, z-index 3, exact 4px piece insets, centered role text, and unchanged piece and football rectangles.
Captured one background-isolation PNG and one normal PNG per viewport through CDP, recorded their encoded sizes, emptied the in-memory base64 fields, and wrote no image file.
Compared pre-change and selected board signatures for Trips and Deep Shell, independently confirmed each selector after a reload, and exited nonzero if any approved contract failed.
driver.disposition: Retained repository verifier. Every approved rendered value emitted as a passing contract is explicitly asserted, and the process exits nonzero on a mismatch.

assertions.mobile_wordmark_contained: pass: one unwrapped heading line at both mobile widths; 390px and 320px responsive score strips both measured 493.5px high
assertions.literal_heading: pass: Chessball at all three viewports
assertions.heading_contrast: pass: the verifier derived rgb(213, 166, 58) from the rendered heading computed style; pixel-sampled minimum WCAG 2 contrast was 7.1439:1 at 1440x900, 6.8599:1 at 390x844, and 6.7401:1 at 320x568 against every composited background pixel in each heading rectangle
assertions.skip_link_heading_focus: pass: keyboard Enter focused #game-workspace with a computed solid 3px outline at all three viewports
assertions.formation_accessible_names: pass: both selects had bound visible labels and bound aria-describedby descriptions
assertions.formation_catalogs: pass: offense and defense each exposed the approved six ordered options
assertions.formation_touch_height: pass: both selects measured exactly 44px high at all three viewports
assertions.formation_colors: pass: both selects computed explicit rgb(249, 231, 182) text on rgb(16, 34, 25) backgrounds
assertions.formation_preview: pass: Trips and Deep Shell updated values, descriptions, and rendered board signatures at all three viewports
assertions.formation_confirmation: pass: independent reloads directly observed both offense and defense selectors and confirmation buttons disabled after their individual confirmation at each of all three viewports
assertions.formation_crowding: pass: descriptions and confirmation buttons did not overlap; measured gap was 7px
assertions.pass_badge: pass: P computed at left 1px and bottom 1px; piece rectangle and 4px inset were identical before/after
assertions.tackle_badge: pass: T computed at left 1px and bottom 1px; piece rectangle and 4px inset were identical before/after
assertions.role_text: pass: rendered role text stayed centered within 1 CSS pixel of the unchanged piece center
assertions.football_marker: pass: computed top/right remained 3px/3px at z-index 3 for both controlled badge states

observations: Native formation controls have visible bound labels, visible bound descriptions, explicit dark-theme colors, touch-action manipulation, and 44px rendered height.
The document retains semantic main content, a skip link, a literal h1, visible focus-visible treatments, and no zoom-disabling viewport directive.

No CSS animation or transition is present, so no reduced-motion override is required; no transition: all, outline suppression, paste blocking, autofocus, image sizing issue, or click-handler navigation anti-pattern was found.
The one-word Chessball heading did not wrap at any tested width; adding text-wrap balancing would not change a single-word heading and was not treated as an implementation defect.

The existing skip-link reveal selector uses :focus so programmatic as well as keyboard focus reveals it; the global :focus-visible rule still supplies the visible 3px ring, directly verified through keyboard activation.

screenshot.disposition: The original run captured 1 normal screenshot per viewport. The first remediation run captured 1 background-isolation and 1 normal screenshot per viewport. Quality hardening ran the three-viewport driver four times (two diagnostic nonzero runs, one fully recorded pass, and one fresh confirmation pass), capturing 24 more background/normal payloads. All 33 base64 payloads were discarded in memory; no PNG, visual hash, or screenshot asset was written or retained.

execution_notes: The first restricted-sandbox Chromium launch exited 133 with crashpad setsockopt: Operation not permitted; the same recorded Chromium command then ran with the approved host permission required for local browser IPC.
The first restricted-sandbox CDP connection failed with connect EPERM 127.0.0.1:9224; the recorded driver command then ran with the approved host permission required for localhost CDP.

contrast_method.sampling: For each viewport, CDP captured a background-only screenshot after temporarily making only the heading text transparent, removing its text-shadow, and hiding its accent pseudo-element. The body gradients remained fully rendered and composited. Chromium decoded the PNG into a canvas, and the verifier compared the computed gold foreground with every pixel in the complete heading rectangle.
contrast_method.shadow_treatment: The text shadow was isolated from the background sample and was not relied upon to pass contrast. A separate normal rendered screenshot retained the shadow for inspection.

asserted_contracts.wordmark: Exact requested viewport; no horizontal overflow; desktop score-strip baseline; literal unwrapped heading; keyboard focus and visible outline; opaque computed foreground RGB reused by the pixel contrast calculation; nonempty background and normal screenshots.
asserted_contracts.formations: Visible bound labels/descriptions; Pending then Confirmed status; exact ordered value/label catalogs; exact 44px select height; exact computed text/background colors; enabled before confirmation; exact 7px nonoverlap gap; exact Trips/Deep Shell values and descriptions; changed board; selector/button presence and disabled state after independent confirmation.
asserted_contracts.badges: Exact P/T content, left 1px, bottom 1px, 10px by 10px, z-index 3; exact 4px piece insets; unchanged full piece and football rectangles and computed marker position; role center within 1 CSS pixel; football top/right 3px and z-index 3.

diagnostic_runs.reason: The first hardened run exposed the previously unenforced pseudo-element placement serialization check.

The diagnostic rerun recorded Chromium resolving the unused right:auto declaration to a pixel value while left:1px and bottom:1px remained exact; the approved contract requires left/bottom placement, not a computed right token.

offense.description: Three eligible receivers overload one side and concede the weak side.

defense.description: Deep, wide coverage protects passes and softens underneath run support.

final_run.fresh_confirmation_rerun: pass: the unchanged hardened driver exited 0 again after the evidence edits

limitations: Rendered verification used one Chromium build and did not cover Firefox, Safari, or other browser/assistive-technology combinations.
The 390px and 320px checks used desktop CDP metrics with the requested innerWidth and deviceScaleFactor 1, not physical mobile-device emulation or physical touch input.
No real screen reader, audible announcement inspection, physical device, or physical board-game session was used.

Pass and tackle overlay geometry was isolated by applying each production target class to the same rendered controlled-ball square; automated application tests separately exercise the real pass/tackle state semantics.
The formation flow was reached through rendered game controls and deterministic UI automation, but the kickoff path varied with the application coin flip and dice results.

Contrast used the foreground RGB derived from the rendered heading computed style against every pixel of a background-only CDP screenshot of the heading rectangle. Text shadow and the accent were removed only to isolate the background and were not relied upon for contrast.
Screenshots were inspected only during the run and are not retained, so this artifact is structured measurement evidence rather than pixel-image equality evidence.
